### P1 "Arraygen.3" (Arraygen) · Expression

```
var v := floor(i / 3) ; 
var c := i - 3 * v; 
var tri := floor(v / 3); 
var j := v - 3 * tri; 
var a0 := tri * 0.157 + pos; 
var a := j == 1 ? a0 : a0 + 0.157;
 var r := j == 0 ? 0 : 1 + 0.3 * sin(tri * sin(pos)); 
c == 0 
  ? r * cos(a) 
  : (c == 1 ? r * sin(a) : 0.2 * sin(tri * 0.5) * (j > 0))
```

// Reverse-Z perspective, same convention as the engine's CameraMath.hpp
// setReverseZPerspective (GL-style NDC in, clipSpaceCorrMatrix remaps).
mat4 gallery_perspective(float fovYDeg, float aspect, float n, float f)
{
    float c = 1.0 / tan(radians(fovYDeg) * 0.5);
    mat4 m = mat4(0.0);
    m[0][0] = c / aspect;
    m[1][1] = c;
    m[2][2] = (f + n) / (f - n);
    m[3][2] = (2.0 * f * n) / (f - n);
    m[2][3] = -1.0;
    return m;
}

### P3 "Render Pipeline.4" (Render Pipeline) · Fragment

description: Gallery viewer for the GEOMETRY path (primitives, mesh loaders, mesh modifiers, CSF producers wired straight into a Render Pipeline). Placement from MODEL_MATRIX (the producer's own Position/Rotation/Scale controls), camera built from the eye/target/fov INPUTS with the engine's reverse-Z perspective (CameraMath.hpp setReverseZPerspective: near maps to NDC +1, far to -1, GREATER compare). Shading:…; categories: GALLERY, Renderer; inputs: eye:point3D=[2,1.5,3], target:point3D=[0,0,0], fov:float=45, lightDir:point3D=[0.4,0.8,0.5], baseColor:color=[0.85,0.55,0.3,1]

```glsl
void main()
{
    vec3 N = v_normal;
    if(dot(N, N) < 1e-8)
        N = normalize(cross(dFdx(v_worldPos), dFdy(v_worldPos)));
    else
        N = normalize(N);

    vec3 V = normalize(eye - v_worldPos);
    if(dot(N, V) < 0.0)
        N = -N; // two-sided: planes and open meshes shade on both faces

    vec3 L = normalize(lightDir);
    vec3 H = normalize(L + V);

    vec3 albedo = baseColor.rgb;

    float hemi = 0.5 + 0.5 * N.y;
    vec3 ambient = mix(vec3(0.10, 0.09, 0.08), vec3(0.28, 0.32, 0.40), hemi);
    float diff = max(dot(N, L), 0.0);
    float spec = pow(max(dot(N, H), 0.0), 48.0) * step(0.0, dot(N, L));

    vec3 col = albedo * (ambient + 0.9 * diff) + 0.35 * spec;
    isf_FragColor = vec4(col, 1.0);
}
```
